column3: easy English meaning of the whole ayah (written for this course; to be reviewed by a scholar)
I begin with the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
All praise is for Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.
The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
The Master of the Day of Judgement.
(O Allah!) You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
Guide us on the straight path.
The path of those You have blessed; not of those who earned Your anger, nor of those who went astray.
What are they asking one another about?
About the great news (the Day of Judgement),
about which they disagree.
No indeed! They will soon know.
Again, no indeed! They will soon know.
Have We not made the earth a resting place,
and the mountains as pegs,
and created you in pairs,
and made your sleep for rest,
and made the night a covering,
and made the day a time to earn a living,
and built above you seven strong (heavens),
and made a blazing lamp (the sun),
and sent down pouring water from the rain clouds,
to bring out grain and plants with it,
and gardens thick with trees?
Surely the Day of Decision is an appointed time,
the Day the Trumpet is blown and you come in crowds,
and the sky is opened and becomes gateways,
and the mountains are moved and become like a mirage.
Surely Hell is lying in wait,
a home for the transgressors,
where they will stay for ages.
There they will taste nothing cool and nothing to drink,
except boiling water and pus,
a fitting reward for what they did.
They never expected a reckoning,
and they completely denied Our signs,
and We have counted everything in writing.
So taste (the punishment); We will only increase you in punishment.
Surely for those who fear Allah there is success:
gardens and grapes,
and young companions of equal age,
and cups full to the brim.
There they will hear no idle talk and no lies,
a reward from your Lord, a gift in full measure,
from the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Most Gracious; no one has the power to speak to Him.
On the Day the Spirit (Jibril) and the angels stand in rows, no one will speak except the one the Most Gracious allows, and he will say what is right.
That Day is the truth; so whoever wills, let him take a way back to his Lord.
We have warned you of a punishment that is near, the Day a person will see what his hands have sent ahead, and the disbeliever will say: I wish I were dust!
By the angels who pull out (the souls of the wicked) harshly,
and by those who draw out (the souls of the believers) gently,
and by those who glide (through the heavens),
then race ahead (to carry out orders),
then arrange affairs (by Allah's command).
On the Day the quaking (earth) quakes,
followed by another (blast),
hearts that Day will be pounding,
and their eyes will be cast down.
They say: Shall we really be returned to our former state?
Even when we have become crumbled bones?
They say: Then that would be a return of great loss!
But it will be only a single shout (the Trumpet),
and at once they will be on open ground.
Has the story of Musa (peace be upon him) reached you?
When his Lord called him in the holy valley of Tuwa:
Go to Pharaoh; he has transgressed,
and say to him: Would you like to purify yourself,
and that I guide you to your Lord so that you fear Him?
Then Musa showed him the greatest sign,
but he denied and disobeyed,
then turned his back, striving (against the truth),
then gathered (his people) and called out,
saying: I am your lord, the most high.
So Allah seized him with the punishment of the Hereafter and of this world.
Surely in this is a lesson for whoever fears (Allah).
Are you harder to create, or the sky? Allah built it,
raised its ceiling high and made it even,
darkened its night and brought out its daylight,
and after that He spread out the earth,
brought out of it its water and its pasture,
and fixed the mountains firmly in it,
as provision for you and your cattle.
Then when the greatest disaster (the Day of Judgement) comes,
that Day man will remember what he strove for,
and Hell will be shown to all who see.
So whoever transgressed,
and preferred the life of this world (over the Hereafter),
Hell will surely be his home.
But whoever feared standing before his Lord and held back his soul from evil desires,
Paradise will surely be his home.
They ask you about the Hour: when will it come?
What have you to do with telling its time?
Its (full) knowledge is with your Lord alone.
You are only a warner for whoever fears it.
On the Day they see it, it will seem as if they had stayed (in the world) only an evening or a morning.
He (the Prophet ﷺ) frowned and turned away,
because a blind man (a Companion) came to him.
And how could you know? Perhaps he would have purified himself,
or taken the reminder, and the reminder would have benefited him.
But the one who thinks himself free of need,
you give your attention to him,
though it is not your duty if he does not purify himself.
And the one who came to you hurrying,
while he fears (Allah),
you give him less attention.
No indeed! This (Quran) is a reminder,
so whoever wills, let him remember it.
It is in honoured pages,
raised high and purified,
in the hands of scribes (angels),
noble and good.
Woe to man! How ungrateful he is!
From what did Allah create him?
From a drop of fluid He created him, then gave him his measure,
then made the way (of life) easy for him,
then gave him death and put him in a grave,
then when He wills, He will raise him up again.
No indeed! He has not yet done what Allah commanded him.
So let man look at his food:
how We poured down water in plenty,
then split the earth open,
then made grain grow in it,
and grapes and vegetables,
and olives and date palms,
and gardens thick with trees,
and fruit and pasture,
as provision for you and your cattle.
Then when the deafening blast (of the Day of Judgement) comes,
that Day a man will flee from his brother,
and from his mother and his father,
and from his wife and his children.
That Day every person will have enough worry of his own to keep him from others.
Some faces that Day will be bright,
laughing and rejoicing.
And some faces that Day will be covered with dust,
covered in darkness.
Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
When the sun is wrapped up,
and when the stars lose their light,
and when the mountains are moved away,
and when the (precious) pregnant camels are left untended,
and when the wild animals are gathered together,
and when the seas are set on fire,
and when the souls are paired (with their like),
and when the girl who was buried alive is asked,
for what sin she was killed,
and when the records of deeds are spread open,
and when the sky is stripped away,
and when Hell is set ablaze,
and when Paradise is brought near,
then every soul will know what it has brought.
So no! I swear by the stars that draw back,
that run their course and hide,
and by the night as it departs,
and by the morning as it breathes (brightens),
surely this (Quran) is the word brought by a noble messenger (Jibril),
full of strength, high in rank with the Owner of the Throne (Allah),
obeyed there, and trustworthy.
And (O people!) your companion (Muhammad ﷺ) is not mad.
He surely saw him (the angel) on the clear horizon.
And he does not hold back what he is told of the unseen.
And this is not the word of a cursed devil.
So where are you going?
It is only a reminder for all the worlds,
for any of you who wants to go straight.
And you cannot will anything unless Allah wills, the Lord of all the worlds.
When the sky is split open,
and when the stars are scattered,
and when the seas burst forth,
and when the graves are turned over,
then every soul will know what it sent ahead and what it left behind.
O man! What has deceived you about your Lord, the Most Generous,
who created you, then shaped you, then made you well balanced,
and put you together in whatever form He willed?
No indeed! Rather, you deny the Day of Judgement,
while over you there are guardians (angels),
noble ones, writing (your deeds),
who know whatever you do.
Surely the righteous will be in bliss,
and surely the wicked will be in Hell,
which they will enter on the Day of Judgement,
and they will never be able to escape it.
And what will make you know what the Day of Judgement is?
Again, what will make you know what the Day of Judgement is?
It is the Day no soul can do anything for another soul, and on that Day the whole command is Allah's.
Woe to those who give short measure,
who take full measure when they take from people,
but give less when they measure or weigh for them.
Do they not think that they will be raised again
for a tremendous Day,
the Day all people will stand before the Lord of all the worlds?
No indeed! The record of the wicked is in "Sijjeen".
And what will make you know what Sijjeen is?
It is a written record.
Woe that Day to the deniers,
who deny the Day of Judgement;
and no one denies it except every sinful transgressor.
When Our verses are recited to him, he says: These are tales of the people of old.
No indeed! Rather, their evil deeds have covered their hearts with rust.
No indeed! That Day they will be kept from (seeing) their Lord,
then they will surely enter Hell,
then it will be said to them: This is what you used to deny.
No indeed! The record of the righteous is in "'Illiyyeen".
And what will make you know what 'Illiyyun is?
It is a written record,
witnessed by those brought near to Allah.
Surely the righteous will be in bliss,
seated on couches, looking (at everything).
You will see in their faces the brightness of bliss.
They will be given a pure, sealed drink,
whose seal is musk; so for this let those who compete, compete.
And it will be mixed with "Tasneem",
a spring from which those brought near to Allah drink.
Surely the criminals used to laugh at the believers (in the world),
and wink at one another when they passed by them,
and return to their families joking,
and when they saw them they said: These people are surely astray.
Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
So today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers,
seated on couches, looking.
Have the disbelievers been repaid for what they used to do?
When the sky is split open,
and listens to its Lord, as it must,
and when the earth is spread out,
and throws out what is inside it and becomes empty,
and listens to its Lord, as it must.
O man! You are working hard on your way to your Lord, and you will meet Him.
Then whoever is given his record in his right hand
will have an easy reckoning,
and will return to his family happy.
But whoever is given his record from behind his back
will call out for death,
and will enter the blazing fire.
He used to be happy and carefree among his family (in the world).
He thought he would never return (to Allah).
Yes indeed! His Lord was always watching him.
So no! I swear by the red glow of sunset,
and by the night and all it gathers,
and by the moon when it becomes full:
you will surely pass from one stage to another.
So what is wrong with them that they do not believe?
And when the Quran is recited to them, they do not prostrate.
Rather, the disbelievers deny,
and Allah knows best what they hide in their hearts.
So give them news of a painful punishment,
except those who believe and do good deeds; for them is a reward that never ends.
By the sky with its great stars,
and by the promised Day,
and by the witness and what is witnessed:
destroyed were the people of the trench,
the fire full of fuel,
when they sat by it (the fire),
watching what they were doing to the believers.
They hated the believers only because they believed in Allah, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy,
to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and Allah sees everything.
Surely those who tortured the believing men and women and then did not repent will have the punishment of Hell and the punishment of burning.
Surely those who believe and do good deeds will have gardens with rivers flowing beneath them; that is the great success.
Surely the grip of your Lord is very strong.
It is He who creates the first time and He will create again,
and He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Loving,
the Owner of the Throne, the Glorious,
who does whatever He wills.
Has the story of the armies reached you,
the armies of Pharaoh and Thamud?
Rather, the disbelievers are busy denying,
and Allah surrounds them from behind.
Rather, this is a glorious Quran,
(written) in the Preserved Tablet.
By the sky and the night visitor!
And what will make you know what the night visitor is?
It is the piercing bright star.
There is no soul that does not have a guardian (angel) over it.
So let man see what he was created from.
He was created from a gushing fluid,
coming from between the backbone and the ribs.
Surely Allah is fully able to bring him back,
on the Day all secrets are tested,
when he will have no strength and no helper.
By the sky that returns the rain,
and by the earth that splits open (for plants),
surely this (Quran) is a decisive word,
and it is not a joke.
Surely they (the disbelievers) are plotting,
and I too am planning.
So (O Prophet ﷺ) give the disbelievers time; give them a little time.
Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,
who created and then made everything well,
who set the measure (of all things) and then guided,
who brought out the pasture (for animals),
then turned it into dry, dark stubble.
We will make you recite (the Quran), and you will not forget,
except what Allah wills; surely He knows what is open and what is hidden.
And We will make it easy for you to follow the easy way (of the religion).
So remind, wherever the reminder benefits.
Whoever fears (Allah) will take the reminder,
but the most wretched will avoid it,
who will enter the greatest Fire,
where he will neither die nor (truly) live.
Surely successful is the one who purifies himself,
and remembers the name of his Lord and prays.
But you prefer the life of this world,
while the Hereafter is better and lasts forever.
Surely this is also in the earlier scriptures,
the scriptures of Ibrahim and Musa (peace be upon them).
Has the story of the Overwhelming (Day) reached you?
Some faces that Day will be humbled,
toiling and weary,
entering a blazing fire,
given water from a boiling spring to drink.
They will have no food except thorny bushes,
which neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
And some faces that Day will be joyful,
pleased with their efforts (in the world),
in a high garden,
where they will hear no idle talk.
In it is a flowing spring,
in it are raised couches,
and cups set out,
and cushions lined up in rows,
and carpets spread out.
Do they not look at the camel, how it was created?
And at the sky, how it was raised high?
And at the mountains, how they were set firm?
And at the earth, how it was spread out?
So (O Prophet ﷺ) remind; you are only one who reminds.
You are not there to force them.
But whoever turns away and disbelieves,
Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
Surely to Us is their return,
then surely their reckoning is up to Us.
By the dawn,
and by the ten nights,
and by the even and the odd,
and by the night as it passes!
Is there not in these an oath enough for one who understands?
Have you not seen what your Lord did with the people of 'Aad,
the people of Iram with lofty pillars,
the like of whom (in strength) was never created in the lands?
And with Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
And with Pharaoh, the owner of the stakes?
All of them transgressed in the lands,
and spread much corruption there,
so your Lord poured on them the scourge of punishment.
Surely your Lord is ever watchful.
As for man, when his Lord tests him by honouring him and blessing him, he says: My Lord has honoured me.
But when He tests him by limiting his provision, he says: My Lord has humiliated me.
No indeed! Rather, you do not honour the orphan,
and you do not urge one another to feed the poor,
and you devour inheritance greedily,
and you love wealth very much.
No indeed! When the earth is pounded to dust,
and your Lord comes (as befits His majesty), with the angels in row after row,
and Hell is brought near that Day; that Day man will understand, but what use is understanding then?
He will say: I wish I had sent something ahead for this life of mine!
So that Day no one will punish as Allah punishes,
and no one will bind as He binds.
(It will be said to the good soul:) O soul at peace!
Return to your Lord, pleased with Him and pleasing to Him,
so enter among My (righteous) servants,
and enter My Paradise.
No! I swear by this city (Makkah),
and (O Prophet ﷺ) you live in this very city,
and by the father (Adam, peace be upon him) and his children:
surely We created man in toil and hardship.
Does he think no one has power over him?
He says: I have spent heaps of wealth.
Does he think no one has seen him?
Have We not given him two eyes,
and a tongue and two lips,
and shown him the two ways (of good and evil)?
Yet he has not attempted the steep path (of good).
And what will make you know what the steep path is?
It is freeing a slave,
or giving food on a day of hunger
to an orphan who is a relative,
or to a poor person in great need,
and then being among those who believe and urge one another to patience and to mercy.
These are the companions of the right hand (the fortunate).
But those who deny Our signs are the companions of the left hand (the unfortunate).
Over them will be a fire closed in on every side.
By the sun and its morning brightness,
and by the moon when it follows it,
and by the day when it shows the sun's brightness,
and by the night when it covers it,
and by the sky and the One who built it,
and by the earth and the One who spread it out,
and by the soul and the One who shaped it well,
then taught it (to know) its wrong and its right:
surely successful is the one who keeps his soul pure,
and surely the one who corrupts it (with sins) has failed.
The people of Thamud denied (their prophet) because of their arrogance,
when the most wretched of them rose up.
Then the messenger of Allah (Salih, peace be upon him) told them: Take care of Allah's she-camel and her turn to drink.
But they denied the messenger and killed the she-camel, so their Lord destroyed them for their sin and levelled them all (to the ground).
And Allah has no fear of what comes after.
By the night when it covers (everything),
and by the day when it shines,
and by the One who created the male and the female:
surely your efforts are of many kinds.
So whoever gives (in Allah's way) and fears Allah,
and believes in the best (Islam),
We will make easy for him the way to ease (Paradise).
But whoever is stingy and thinks himself free of need,
and denies the best,
We will let him go the way to hardship (Hell).
And his wealth will not help him at all when he falls (into the pit).
Surely it is up to Us to show the way,
and surely the Hereafter and this world belong to Us.
So I have warned you of a blazing fire.
Only the most wretched will enter it,
who denied and turned away.
And the most God-fearing will be kept away from it,
who gives his wealth to purify himself,
not to repay a favour anyone has done him,
but only seeking the pleasure of his Lord, the Most High;
and he will surely soon be pleased.
By the morning brightness,
and by the night when it is still:
(O Prophet ﷺ) your Lord has not left you, nor is He displeased.
And surely the Hereafter is better for you than this world.
And soon your Lord will give you so much that you will be pleased.
Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?
And He found you unaware of the way and guided you,
and He found you in need and made you free of need.
So do not be harsh with the orphan,
and do not turn away the one who asks,
and speak of the blessings of your Lord.
(O Prophet ﷺ) Have We not opened your chest for you?
And We took off from you the burden
that weighed so heavily on your back,
and We raised your mention high for you.
So surely with hardship comes ease.
Surely with hardship comes ease.
So when you are free (from your work), work hard (in worship),
and turn your heart to your Lord alone.
By the fig and the olive,
and by Mount Sinai,
and by this secure city (Makkah):
surely We created man in the best form.
Then We returned him to the lowest of the low,
except those who believe and do good deeds; for them is a reward that never ends.
So after this, what makes you deny the Day of Judgement?
Is not Allah the most just of all judges?
(O Prophet ﷺ) Read in the name of your Lord who created (everything).
He created man from a clinging clot (of blood).
Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous,
who taught by means of the pen,
taught man what he did not know.
No indeed! Surely man transgresses,
when he sees himself free of need (rich).
Surely to your Lord is the return (of everyone).
Have you seen the one who forbids
a servant when he prays?
Tell me, if he (the servant) is on guidance,
or commands fear of Allah (how can he be stopped)?
Tell me, if he (the one who forbids) denies and turns away,
does he not know that Allah sees?
No indeed! If he does not stop, We will drag him by the forelock,
a lying, sinful forelock.
Then let him call his gathering;
We will call the angels (of Hell).
No indeed! Do not obey him; prostrate and come near (to Allah).
Surely We sent it (the Quran) down on the Night of Power.
And what will make you know what the Night of Power is?
The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
On that night the angels and the Spirit (Jibril) come down by their Lord's permission with every matter.
That night is all peace, until the rise of dawn.
Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book and the idol-worshippers were not going to stop (their disbelief) until the clear proof came to them:
a messenger from Allah, reciting purified pages,
in which are upright and true teachings.
And the People of the Book divided only after the clear proof had come to them.
Yet they were commanded only to worship Allah, keeping the religion sincerely for Him, turning to Him alone, to establish prayer and to give zakah — and that is the upright religion.
Surely those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idol-worshippers will stay forever in the fire of Hell; they are the worst of all creation.
Surely those who believe and do good deeds are the best of all creation.

Their reward with their Lord is gardens of eternity with rivers flowing beneath them, where they will stay forever and ever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is for whoever fears his Lord.
When the earth is shaken with its great shaking,
and the earth brings out its burdens (from inside),
and man says: What is wrong with it?
That Day the earth will tell all its news,
because your Lord will have commanded it.
That Day people will come out in separate groups to be shown their deeds.
So whoever has done an atom's weight of good will see it,
and whoever has done an atom's weight of evil will see it too.
By the horses that race, panting,
then strike sparks with their hooves (on the stones),
then raid at dawn,
then raise clouds of dust,
then charge into the middle of the (enemy) army!
Surely man is very ungrateful to his Lord,
and he himself is a witness to this,
and he loves wealth very strongly.
Does he not know that when what is in the graves is brought out,
and what is in the chests (hearts) is made known,
surely their Lord will be fully aware of them that Day?
The Striking Calamity (the Day of Judgement)!
What is the Striking Calamity?
And what will make you know what the Striking Calamity is?
The Day people will be like scattered moths,
and the mountains will be like fluffed-up coloured wool.
Then whoever's scales (of good deeds) are heavy
will be in a happy life.
But whoever's scales are light,
his home will be "Haawiyah" (the deep pit).
And what will make you know what it is?
It is a blazing fire.
The race for more and more (wealth and pride) has distracted you,
until you reach the graves.
No indeed! You will soon know.
Again, no indeed! You will soon know.
No indeed! If only you knew with certainty (you would not do this).
You will surely see Hell.
Then you will surely see it with your own eyes, with certainty.
Then on that Day you will surely be asked about the blessings.
By time!
Surely mankind is at a loss.
Except those who believe, do good deeds, urge one another to the truth and urge one another to patience.
Woe to every person who mocks to the face and finds faults behind the back,
who gathers wealth and keeps counting it.
He thinks his wealth will make him live forever.
No indeed! He will surely be thrown into "al-Hutamah".
And what will make you know what al-Hutamah is?
It is the fire of Allah, kindled,
which reaches up to the hearts.
It will be closed in over them from every side,
in long stretched-out columns.
Have you not seen what your Lord did to the people of the elephant?
Did He not make their plan fail?
And He sent against them birds in flocks,
which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
and He made them like straw that has been eaten.
Because the Quraysh were made used to (travelling) —
used to their journeys in winter and summer —
so let them worship the Lord of this House (the Ka'bah),
who fed them when they were hungry and made them safe from fear.
Have you seen the one who denies the Day of Judgement?
He is the one who pushes the orphan away,
and does not encourage feeding the poor.
So woe to those who pray,
who are careless about their prayer,
who do (good) only to be seen,
and refuse even small kindnesses (like lending things of daily use).
(O Prophet ﷺ) We have given you al-Kawthar (abundant good, and a river in Paradise).
So pray to your Lord and make a sacrifice.
Surely it is your enemy who will be cut off and forgotten.
(O Prophet ﷺ) say: O disbelievers!
I do not worship what you worship,
nor do you worship what I worship,
nor will I worship what you have worshipped,
nor will you worship what I worship.
For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.
When the help of Allah and the victory come,
and you see people entering the religion of Allah in crowds,
then glorify your Lord with His praise and ask His forgiveness; surely He always accepts repentance.
Perish the two hands of Abu Lahab, and he has perished.
Neither his wealth nor what he earned helped him.
He will soon burn in a fire of blazing flames,
and his wife too, who carried the (thorny) firewood.
Around her neck will be a rope of twisted palm fibre.
(O Prophet ﷺ) say: He is Allah, the One.
Allah is the Self-Sufficient; He needs no one, and everyone needs Him.
He has no child, and He is no one's child.
And there is nothing equal to Him.
(O Prophet ﷺ) say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,
from the evil of everything He has created,
and from the evil of the dark night when it spreads,
and from the evil of those who blow on knots (who do magic),
and from the evil of the envier when he envies.
(O Prophet ﷺ) say: I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,
the King of mankind,
the God of mankind,
from the evil of the whisperer who slinks away (when Allah is remembered),
who whispers into the hearts of people,
whether he is from the jinn or from mankind.
